title: Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Antique Brass | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass | Wall-Mounted Bath Towel Bar Holder | Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping towels over the door or vanity in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This wall-mounted towel bar (also called a towel rack or towel holder) adds a dedicated, easy-to-reach hanging spot in the bathroom while matching classic, traditional décor.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Coordinates with other Carolina accessories for a curated, collected look
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maximize bathroom wall space with a wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging design

Specs & Installation:
- Product: towel bar / towel rack / towel holder
- Collection: Carolina Collection (traditional bathroom hardware; heritage bathroom fixtures styling)
- Length: 30-Inch
- Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 2 in D x 3.5 in H
- Weight: 3.2 lbs
- Material: solid brass (brass construction)
- Mounting: wall mount with concealed screw mounting; mounting hardware included
multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
